To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) in the first 2 years of life, ILD in children is associated with a wide spectrum of histological patterns; (2) these histological patterns can be classified in a simple and reproducible manner; (3) this classification is associated with clinical outcome; (4) the histological patterns are associated with different clinical presentations; and (5) these findings have important implications for future research and management.
